translated_title: INAH Discovers Ceremonial Plaza and Stela of an Unknown Culture in Coatepec, Veracruz
original_title: INAH descubre plaza ceremonial y estela de cultura desconocida en Coatepec, Veracruz
author: Ana Mónica Rodríguez
meta_description: INAH archaeologists in Coatepec, Veracruz, uncovered a civic-ceremonial platform and a 1.88-meter andesite stela with Mayoid features, tentatively dated to the Protoclassic period (200 BC–200 AD).
